title: Duke Fishron and the Empress of Light: phase three, ocean enrage, lethal daylight Empress
player_outcome: Duke Fishron gets a third, frantic phase below 15% and turns savage if you leave the ocean. The Empress of Light is lethal if you fight her in daylight, which is what the Terraprisma challenge is built on.
design: duke_fishron: add phase 3 (below 0.15) with faster dashes, teleport-dash chains and speed 1.7.
Duke enrage {when [{type biome, none [ocean]}], damage 2, speed 1.5, setDefense 100}.
Duke Expert {speed 1.15}; phase thresholds per Terraria Expert via expertBelow if desired.
empress_of_light: despawnAtDay false; enrage {when [{type time, is day}], setDamage 9999, speed 1.2, latch true, message 'The Empress of Light is furious!'}.
data_changes: Duke phase 3 and ocean enrage; Empress daylight enrage.
tests: Smoke bosses.cmds, after the existing 'time 22' and 'boss empress_of_light 14': 'assert boss.empress_of_light.frenzied == 0'.
risks: The existing smoke summons Duke in a forest arena, so he will be enraged. Harmless under god mode; note it.
